sentences.text:
2. This writ petition is filed by the brother of detenu- Arjun Singh Thilpitya challenging the order of detention dated 26.11.2021 made under Section 3 (2) of the Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug-Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders,
Land-Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticide Offenders, Fertilizer Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Documents Offenders, Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders, Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders,
Cyber Crime offenders and White Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986 (Act 1 of 1986).

entities.text: Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug-Offenders, Goondas
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
3. Heard Smt B.Mohana Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Government Pleader for Home representing learned Advocate General appearing for the respondents.
4.
The order of detention is passed basing on the alleged involvement of detenu in four crimes registered between 08.03.2021 and 21.03.2021.
The allegation in all the four crimes relate to theft of construction material.
The detenu was granted conditional bail in all the four crimes and he was released on 10.05.2021.
The detenu was the Accused No.1 in all the four crimes.
5. According to learned counsel for the petitioner, the detenu is complying with the conditions imposed in the bail order by appearing before the concerned Station House Officer.
She further submits that after the release of detenu, till the order of detention was passed, the detenue was not involved in any other crime.
6. These two facts are not disputed by learned Government Pleader.
No justification is shown for resorting to preventive detention after six months of release from bail, more so, when the detenu is not involved in any further crimes.

The crimes alleged against the detenu are normal crimes, which can be looked into in ordinary enforcement of law and order and does not warrant extreme measure of preventively detaining the detenu invoking the power under Act 1 of 1986.
Therefore, the Order of detention is not sustainable.
Accordingly it is set aside.
7. In the result, the Writ Petition is allowed.
The impugned detention order passed by the Office of the Commissioner of Police, Cyberabad Commissionerate-2nd respondent vide No.172/PD- CELL/CYB/2021 dated 26.11.2021 is hereby set aside.

sentences.text: The respondents are directed to set the detenu, namely Arjun Singh Thilpitya S/o.

Late Rathod Singh, Aged about 28 yrs, Occu : Welder R/o.H.No.119-194, Rodamesthri Nagar, Gajularamaram, Jeedimetla, Medchal District at liberty forthwith, if he is no longer required in any other criminal case.
Pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, shall stand closed.
